decisions.decision: Use one global generated-C ordinary-identifier allocator that preserves legacy preferred names when unique and suffixes only actual collisions.
decisions.rationale: This closes cross-category C collisions without violating frozen Phase 1/2 golden compatibility.

decisions.decision: Every compiler-spawned process, including metadata/tool-identity probes, gets a timeout and independent bounded stdout/stderr.
decisions.rationale: Auxiliary probes are part of the untrusted process boundary and can otherwise exhaust memory or hang verification.

decisions.decision: Preserve source-to-core-to-native semantic identity as the future debugging seam; add native symbol/crash infrastructure incrementally.
decisions.rationale: It enables AI/human root-cause evidence without forcing a proof assistant or production crash platform into the v1 kernel.
